question: What worldly consequence may result from a defect in that ritual limb?
premises: A ritual limb may be defective.
Ritual defects can have worldly effects.
The affected materials correspond to the defective limb.
inference: A defect in that ritual limb may result in the destruction of the corresponding substances in the world.
plain_english: If there is a defect in that part of the ritual, the corresponding materials in the world may be destroyed.
